title: Very Many Crafts!
description: This datapack adds over 60 new crafting recipes for existing in-game items—such as golden apples and cobwebs—making it perfect for SMPs, chill survival servers, or single-player worlds!
body:
This datapack adds over 60 new crafting recipes for existing in-game items—such as golden apples and cobwebs—making it perfect for SMPs, chill survival servers, or single-player worlds!

! The datapack isn't finished yet; it currently only supports version 1.21.11. For now, the only way to view all the new recipes is by using the command " /recipe give @p * " 

Have fun with this datapack I hope you enjoy it!
